scope: co-IP from cleared lysate performed by incubation with 10 μl washed GFP-Trap Agarose (ChromoTek) for 2 h at 4 °C
relevant bands excised and analyzed by LC-MS/MS
To identify a cell surface receptor of C1QTNF4, we used a recombinant GFP-C1QTNF4 fusion protein produced in E. coli as bait

Co-immunoprecipitation (co-IP) studies were performed by GFP-Trap with the SK-N-AS neuroblastoma cell line and samples were separated by SDS-PAGE and stained with Coomassie. We identified a band at approximately 100 kDa that was unique to the GFP-C1QTNF4-treated samples (Fig. 1A), which was excised and analyzed by liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS)
